question: Find the display name of the user whose posts mentioning 'Bayesian' have the highest combined favorite count among users who also posted on July 21, 2010.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
JOIN posts AS p ON u."XCL_052" = p."XCL_033"
WHERE p."XCL_035" LIKE '%Bayesian%'
  AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT p2."XCL_033"
    FROM posts AS p2
    WHERE p2."XCL_029" >= '2010-07-21' AND p2."XCL_029" < '2010-07-22'
  )
GROUP BY u."XCL_052"
ORDER BY SUM(p."XCL_039") DESC
LIMIT 1
